comment.body: Thanks for the screenshots and for identifying Crop and Lock's reparent mode and the browser blackout/hang. The browser and version are not named, and the exact crop selection sequence is unclear. Could you provide the browser name and About-version, then list the steps from opening the page through creating and closing the reparented crop? Please also confirm whether closing it restores the browser or whether a restart is still required. This will distinguish a browser-specific rendering interaction from another Crop and Lock hosting path and let maintainers reproduce the failure.
